files.users.json: Array<{userId,login,displayName,orgLogin,teams:string[],persona,licenseAssignedDate}>; synthetic GitHub IDs, team slugs. Dates relative to manifest.anchorDate.
files.usage.ndjson.gz: gzip UTF-8 NDJSON of CopilotUsageRecord (snake_case API fields), with _orgLogin and _teamGithubId ingestion metadata; only active user-days. All feature/IDE/language/model/CLI/version/LOC/credit/phase fields populated.
files.org-aggregates.json.gz: Gzipped Array<CopilotAggregateRecord>; flat API day records with _scope enterprise|organization and _orgLogin for organizations; rolling 7/28-day unique active users, activity totals, CLI totals, pull_requests, totals_by_ai_adoption_phase, and pull_requests.copilot_suggestions_by_comment_type.
files.seats.json: Array<CopilotSeat> in billing/seats API shape: {created_at,updated_at,pending_cancellation_date,last_activity_at,last_authenticated_at,last_activity_editor,plan_type,assignee:{id,login},assigning_team:{id,name,slug}|null,organization?:{id,login}}. Snapshot date is manifest.anchorDate; no wrapper.
files.ai-credit-usage.json.gz: Gzipped Array<fact_ai_credit_usage insert rows using camelCase Drizzle columns>: {enterpriseSlug,periodYear,periodMonth,usageDate,product,sku,model,costCenter,orgName,userLogin,teamName,unitType,pricePerUnit,grossQuantity,discountQuantity,netQuantity,grossAmount,discountAmount,netAmount}. Numeric columns are JSON numbers; stringify when inserting Drizzle numeric columns. No database-generated id/capturedAt. Daily rows by user/model/org/team across seven periods.
files.premium-requests.json.gz: Gzipped {anchorDate,periods:Array<{year,month,usageItems:Array<{date,organizationName,repositoryName,user,team,sku,unitType,grossQuantity,grossAmount,discountAmount,netQuantity,netAmount}>}>}; each period is a raw GitHub BillingUsageResponse plus year/month selectors. Model identifier is sku. Dates span the complete usage period.

notes: All people, organizations, teams, IDs, repositories, workloads and amounts are synthetic. Never use these fixtures as billing estimates.
Arrays intentionally follow the agreed loader contract without envelopes; their date anchor is manifest.anchorDate. premium-requests includes its own anchorDate.
Shift ISO dates/timestamps by today minus anchorDate; derive billing periodYear/periodMonth and premium year/month from the shifted usage dates, regrouping rows if month boundaries change.

Dormant users have seats but no usage records; churned users stop after day 105, and several users onboard on days 45/90. Zero-activity days are omitted because reports count fact rows as active users.
PR counts are derived synthetic outcomes; median merge times are illustrative. Aggregate averages use the same daily cohort members and counts, with rounding to two decimals.

Billing discounts are capped per user/month at synthetic plan entitlements ($19/$39 base, $30/$70 promotional June-August); premium discounts are capped at 300/1000 requests. Both included and additional usage are populated.
Credit quantities match the per-user ai_credits_used signal for this synthetic dataset only; billing and consumption are distinct in real GitHub data.
Premium fixtures include April–October 2026 for demo replay, despite the live premium API cutoff of May 2026. Demo routes must choose fixture periods rather than apply the live cutoff.
